Private wb As Workbook
Private ws As Worksheet

Private Function Shown(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then Shown = "Null" Else Shown = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End Function

Public Function Creators() As String
    Dim s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    wb.Names.Add "First", "=1"
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "x"
    ws.Range("A1").AddComment "note"
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(Application.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Font.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Interior.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Borders.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Borders(xlEdgeTop).Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Names.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Names(1).Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(Application.Windows.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ActiveWindow.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Hyperlinks.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Sheets.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Worksheets.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(Application.Workbooks.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Shapes.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Comments.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.ListObjects.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Validation.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").FormatConditions.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.PageSetup.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1:B2,D4").Areas.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").Characters.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Styles.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.Styles(1).Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(Application.WorksheetFunction.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Sort.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Outline.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.VPageBreaks.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Cells.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Rows.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(ws.Range("A1").EntireColumn.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "|" & Shown(wb.BuiltinDocumentProperties.Creator)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = s & "Err " & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Creators = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 2
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 3
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent -10
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 250
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 1
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 2.6
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent "1"
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent "x"
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").IndentLevel = 0
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").HorizontalAlignment)
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").InsertIndent 1
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("A1").HorizontalAlignment)
    Case 10
        ws.Range("B1").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter: ws.Range("B1").InsertIndent 1
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("B1").HorizontalAlignment & " " & ws.Range("B1").IndentLevel)
    Case 11
        ws.Range("C1").HorizontalAlignment = xlRight: ws.Range("C1").InsertIndent 1
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("C1").HorizontalAlignment & " " & ws.Range("C1").IndentLevel)
    Case 12
        ws.Range("D1").IndentLevel = 3: ws.Range("D2").IndentLevel = 5: ws.Range("D1:D2").InsertIndent 1
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("D1").IndentLevel & " " & ws.Range("D2").IndentLevel & " " & IsNull(ws.Range("D1:D2").IndentLevel))
    Case 13
        ws.Range("E1").InsertIndent 0
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("E1").IndentLevel & " " & ws.Range("E1").HorizontalAlignment)
    Case 14
        ws.Range("F1").IndentLevel = 249: ws.Range("F1").InsertIndent 2
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("F1").IndentLevel)
    Case 15
        ws.Range("G1").InsertIndent 251
        Tried = Shown(ws.Range("G1").IndentLevel)
    Case 16
        Tried = Shown(wb.HasVBProject)
    Case 17
        Tried = Shown(ThisWorkbook.HasVBProject)
    Case 18
        Tried = Shown(wb.CheckCompatibility)
    Case 19
        wb.CheckCompatibility = True
        Tried = Shown(wb.CheckCompatibility & " " & wb.Saved)
    Case 20
        wb.CheckCompatibility = "x"
        Tried = Shown(wb.CheckCompatibility)
    Case 21
        wb.Names.Add "Zed", "=1": wb.Names.Add "Alpha", "=2": wb.Names.Add "mid", "=3"
        Tried = Shown(wb.Names("Zed").Index & " " & wb.Names("Alpha").Index & " " & wb.Names("mid").Index & " " & wb.Names(1).Name)
    Case 22
        ws.Names.Add "Local", "=4"
        Tried = Shown(wb.Names("Sheet1!Local").Index & " " & ws.Names("Local").Index)
    Case 23
        Tried = Shown(TypeName(wb.Names.Parent) & " " & TypeName(wb.Names.Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.Names.Parent))
    Case 24
        Tried = Shown(TypeName(wb.Names(1).Parent) & " " & TypeName(wb.Names(1).Application))
    End Select
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function Cases() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:G1").Value = "x"
    For i = 0 To 24
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i)
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Cases = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
